tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Shared with the site. The app icon's outer arc (AppIcon.icon). The apps use it only inside the icon; it is not a UI colour.

tokens.name: brand-2
tokens.usage: Shared with the site. The icon's inner arc. Illustration only, beside brand.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Shared with the site. The icon's four-point spark. Illustration only.

tokens.name: icon-ground
tokens.usage: Shared with the site. The app icon tile (AppIcon.icon fill, Display P3). Behind the icon in onboarding and About.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: The app's canvas under every screen (OverviewBase). Plum-black in dark, lavender-white in light. SwiftUI: OverviewStyle.base.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Top stop of the overview wash (OverviewBackground): a vertical gradient from this at 0%, through wash-mid at 40%, to clear at 70%, on base. Overview screen only. Never a fill or text colour.

tokens.name: wash-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop (40%) of the overview wash: accent at 12% dark, 5% light.

tokens.name: wash-glow
tokens.usage: Radial glow over the wash, centred top-trailing, radius 85% of the screen width: accent at 35% dark, 12% light.

tokens.name: surface-glow
tokens.usage: BrandSurfaceBackground, behind service sheets and analytics: one radial glow at (50%, 38%) of a 320pt band, radius 210pt, on base. Quieter than the overview wash so a sheet reads as a layer above it.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Stand-in for .glassEffect(.regular) and .regularMaterial in HTML mockups: the iOS toolbar, the demo banner and other glass surfaces. Service cards and Mac rows use overview-glass, not this.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Raised glass in mockups (Figma glass/fill-raised, #ffffff1c): toolbar capsules and controls on glass. Light is an approximation.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim on glass in mockups (Figma glass/stroke, #ffffff24). Light is an approximation. Decorative.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Approximation of the system glass highlight, a 1px top edge in mockups. Decorative.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Service names, plan lines, titles, notice titles (OverviewPrimary). 14:1 or better on base and glass in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Footnotes, spend lines, status lines ('Couldn't update · Saved reading'), freshness (OverviewSecondary). Dark: 6.4:1 on glass. Light: 3.6:1 on glass, kept exact from the app (it is Apple's secondaryLabel); use it only for 13pt+ text that is never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Chevrons, dismiss glyphs, dashed 'not reported' tracks (OverviewTertiary). Fails 3:1 by design, as Apple's tertiaryLabel does; never for words that must be read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rings and dial numbers on iOS and in the Mac account list (OverviewAccent; overviewAccent on the Mac). The iOS app tint: links, toggles, prominent buttons, the notice link. Light is 4.0:1 on light glass.

tokens.name: gauge-accent
tokens.usage: Mac only: gauges and numbers in the service detail view and the Mac analytics (gaugeAccent, PR #123). 6.4:1 on light glass, 5.8:1 on dark glass.

tokens.name: reset-accent
tokens.usage: Reset captions on cards and Mac account rows ('5h resets 3:40 PM', 'Monthly resets Nov 1, 12:00 AM'). OverviewResetAccent. 6.9:1 on dark glass, 7.7:1 on light glass.

tokens.name: gauge-ink
tokens.usage: Mac only: reset captions in the service detail view, on the translucent sheet (gaugeAccentInk). 7:1 or better.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Mac BrandAccent: the Mac app's accent colour (asset catalog AccentColor role). White on it is 5.0:1 dark, 7.8:1 light.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: The white label the system draws on prominent (glassProminent) buttons.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Device hardware in mockups only: the Dynamic Island, the phone bezel.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: The whole dial, rings and numbers, when the worst window reaches 85% (OverviewWarning). Also warning lines in service sheets and Mac rows. Light is 2.1:1 on light glass.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: The whole dial at 95% or more (OverviewCritical). Also the Disconnect button. Light is 3.4:1 on light glass.

tokens.name: overview-glass
tokens.usage: The service card surface: iOS cards at rest, Mac rows on hover and focus, the Mac refresh button and footer buttons on hover (overviewGlass, accent at 6%). Flat: no blur, border or shadow.

tokens.name: overview-glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The 1pt top line inside the card surface, and the pressed Mac footer button (overviewGlassHighlight, accent at 10%).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: quaternarySystemFill: iOS chart and loading placeholders, and the demo banner ground. Dials no longer use it.

tokens.name: overview-track
tokens.usage: Dial tracks on both platforms, placeholder bars, and empty heatmap cells (overviewTrack, white or black at 10%).

tokens.name: notice-edge
tokens.usage: The 1pt border on the reset notice, iOS and Mac (primary at 16%). Cards and rows have no border.

tokens.name: notice-tint
tokens.usage: The Mac reset notice banner fill: accent at 22% over regularMaterial.

tokens.name: sheet-tint
tokens.usage: The Mac menu-bar sheet's tint (sheetTint), over ultraThinMaterial at 70% opacity on macOS 26. Settled 2026-10-22 (PR #122).

tokens.name: sheet-glow
tokens.usage: Mac sheet glow from the top-leading corner, elliptical, to clear at 75% (sheetGlow).

tokens.name: sheet-glow-trailing
tokens.usage: Mac sheet counter-glow from the bottom-trailing corner, to clear at 60% (sheetGlowTrailing).

tokens.name: sheet-rim
tokens.usage: Mac sheet specular rim, a 1px gradient stroke: full at top-leading, 15% at 35%, clear at 60%, 35% at bottom-trailing (sheetRim).

tokens.name: heat-none
tokens.usage: Token heatmap day with no record (Color.secondary at 18%).

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Token heatmap day with a reported zero.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Token heatmap, lowest quartile of active days.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Token heatmap, second quartile.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Token heatmap, third quartile.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Token heatmap, busiest quartile. Dark brightens toward use, light darkens.

tokens.name: widget-ground
tokens.usage: Full-colour Home Screen widget ground, flat (HomeWidgetBackground). Widgets stay dark in both themes.

tokens.name: widget-ink
tokens.usage: Widget text and, on the Lock Screen, every mark (the vibrant pipeline renders primary ink).

tokens.name: widget-secondary
tokens.usage: Widget dial with no reading or an older reading, the older-reading clock, split coverage (WidgetPalette.secondary).

tokens.name: widget-track
tokens.usage: Widget dial tracks (WidgetPalette.track); dashed 2/3pt when a window is missing or the account needs reconnecting.

tokens.name: widget-accent
tokens.usage: Widget dial under 85% (WidgetPalette.accent).

tokens.name: widget-reset
tokens.usage: Widget status and reset captions (WidgetPalette.reset).

tokens.name: widget-warning
tokens.usage: Widget dial from 85%.

tokens.name: widget-critical
tokens.usage: Widget dial from 95%.

tokens.name: widget-heat-none
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap day with no record (secondary at 18%).

tokens.name: widget-heat-0
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap day with a reported zero.

tokens.name: widget-heat-1
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap, lowest quartile; third weekly-split segment.

tokens.name: widget-heat-2
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap, second quartile; second weekly-split segment.

tokens.name: widget-heat-3
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap, third quartile.

tokens.name: widget-heat-4
tokens.usage: Widget heatmap, top quartile; first weekly-split segment.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Inline navigation titles in service sheets ('Codex'). Text style .headline.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Service name on an iOS card or Mac row: 20pt semibold, tracking -0.25, primary. On iOS it scales with .title3.

styles.name: card-detail
styles.usage: The plan line under the service name ("Pro plan · Work"), and "Not connected" on a placeholder row: 13pt semibold, primary. Scales with .footnote on iOS.

styles.name: card-caption
styles.usage: Reset captions (reset-accent, monospaced digits), spend lines and status (secondary, or warning for an error) on an iOS card or Mac row; "Monthly" under a monthly dial.

styles.name: notice
styles.usage: The reset notice on iOS and the Mac: title semibold in primary, link regular in accent. Scales with .subheadline on iOS.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text in forms and onboarding. Text style .body. The notice banner uses notice, not this.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Warning lines in service sheets, in warning. Text style .callout.
styles.sample: Couldn’t update details. Your last reading is retained.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: The plan line at the top of a service sheet, in secondary. Text style .subheadline.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Freshness line under the cards, "Allowance · Updated …" in sheets, form footers. Text style .footnote, in secondary.

styles.name: caption2
styles.usage: Small chart labels in the analytics and enterprise views. Text style .caption2.

styles.name: dial-value
styles.usage: Readings inside the 108pt dial on both platforms: 16pt semibold, monospaced digits, in the dial tint, 80pt wide, scaling down to 85%. Both readings the same size.

styles.name: mac-footer
styles.usage: Settings, Quit and the freshness time in the Mac sheet footer.

spacing.note: The steps the SwiftUI views use. Cards pad 16, the dial sits 24 from its details, cards stack 24 apart.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between the two dial readings; plan line under a Codex name.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between stacked reset captions; heatmap grid to month labels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Glyph to readings in a card dial; notice title to link.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card text stack; dial content to heatmap; between banner and dismiss.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Notice vertical padding; dial above details in the stacked card layout; Mac header bottom.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen gutter, Mac sheet side padding, notice horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Overview top and bottom padding; Mac dial to details.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between overview sections and cards; dial to details in the column layout.

radius.note: Liquid Glass shapes are concentric: an inner radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Token heatmap cells.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Chart loading bars.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chart placeholders and small fills.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Mac hover buttons (AnalyticsHoverButtonStyle).

tokens.name: radius-account
tokens.usage: Account surfaces on both platforms: iOS service cards, Mac rows (seen on hover) and the notice banner (OverviewStyle.accountRadius, 24).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: iOS glass surfaces still on OverviewCardMaterial: the demo banner and enterprise detail cards (OverviewStyle.radius). Not service cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Glass buttons, toolbar buttons, the Mac refresh circle.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Each ring of a two-window dial, iOS and Mac.

tokens.name: ring-single
tokens.usage: The one ring of a single-window or monthly dial.

tokens.name: ring-inset
tokens.usage: How far the inner (7d) ring sits inside the outer.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Glass rims, Mac card borders, the sheet rim.

tokens.name: dial
tokens.usage: The dial on both platforms (MacAccountDial geometry). iOS scales it with Dynamic Type (@ScaledMetric, capped at 200) and every ratio with it. Its frame is trimmed to 103px tall below the open arc.

tokens.name: dial-outset
tokens.usage: How far the outer stroke reaches past the dial frame (strokeOutset). The heatmap is outset by the same amount so it lines up with the ring edge.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Service glyph inside a card or Mac dial.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (dismiss buttons, toolbar).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Overview column width cap on iPad.

tokens.name: ring-secondary
tokens.usage: The inner 7d ring and its reading. 0.9 with Increase Contrast on iOS.

blur.note: Approximations for HTML mockups only. The apps use .glassEffect(.regular) on iOS 26 (.regularMaterial before) and the Mac sheet recipe in PopoverView.swift.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Glass previews (Figma effect AIQuota/Glass Blur, radius 30).

tokens.name: sheet-blur
tokens.usage: Mac sheet previews: stands in for ultraThinMaterial at 70%.

figma: AIQuota (cja43k0cJmCFUnGctkDuJ2), AIQuota Tokens collection, dark mode
